title: gentianella crispata f. candida
intro: Gentianella crispata f. candida, commonly known as a type of alpine gentian, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestion and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and nausea. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella crispata f. candida are attributed to its bitter properties, which are known to stimulate digestive enzymes and enhance the absorption of nutrients. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as gentiopicroside and amarogenti, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
